verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents Identity Resolution linking cross-device/channel signals into a unified identity with a Golden Record built via survivorship rules, and describes unifying data across sources — directly addressing stitching known/anonymous activity into one profile. However, the docs shown don't detail configurable matching rules (e.g., deterministic vs probabilistic matching logic, field-level match keys) beyond survivorship for golden records, and there's no independent/hands-on validation of identity-resolution accuracy. Missing for 10: documentation of specific configurable match-rule types (deterministic/probabilistic, custom match keys), worked examples of anonymous-to-known stitching, and independent verification of resolution quality.
